description: Read one fix guide: the causes, how to check which one applies, and the fix for each, step by step. Use a slug from lookup_error or list_guides. By default it returns the whole guide; to save tokens, set outline to true to get only its numbered sections, then pass section to read just one.

outline.description: Only the title, summary and numbered section headings.

section.description: Only this section, by its number in the outline.

name: get_guide
title: Read a fix guide
